summary: GitHub-tool chat integration tested end-to-end in the real UI. READ path works: after connecting the PAT, Promethius (GPT-4o-mini) executed read_github_file and answered '# Here are your Instructions' verbatim. PUSH path partly works: propose_github_push is emitted by the backend, ChatPanel auto-opens GithubPush at the REVIEW step prefilled with branch 'prom-chat-uitest', file 'HELLO_UITEST.md', commit message 'Create HELLO_UITEST.md with greeting', and header shows @rocosfsintec-del. However, clicking 'Approve & Push' fails with HTTP 404 from /api/github/commit -> GitHub GET /git/ref/heads/prom-chat-uitest returned 404. RCA: when the assistant proposes a NEW branch (create_branch=true), the payload only carries the target branch; GithubPush sets repo.default_branch = initialProposal.branch (the NEW branch), so the commit call sends base_branch='prom-chat-uitest' (the branch we're trying to create) instead of the repo's actual default branch ('main'). Approval gate itself is intact: nothing was committed until Approve was clicked.
ai_feature_verdicts: Chat -> GitHub read tool (list/read_github_file via GPT-4o-mini) - pass - evidence: /api/github/token 200, backend httpx GET /repos/rocosfsintec-del/Promethius/contents/README.md?ref=main 200, assistant reply 'The first line of the README.md is:\n\n"# Here are your Instructions"'. Skill: ai-testing-llm.

Chat -> propose_github_push auto-opens review dialog - pass - evidence: after 'Create a file HELLO_UITEST.md... on new branch prom-chat-uitest', GithubPush dialog opened automatically at step='review' with header @ROCOSFSINTEC-DEL, banner 'Confirm before pushing rocosfsintec-del/Promethius on branch prom-chat-uitest (new branch)', file HELLO_UITEST.md (1 line, 2 chars), toast 'Promethius prepared a push - review & approve it'. Skill: ai-testing-llm.

Chat -> approve-and-push commit (real GitHub commit) - fail - evidence: click on [data-testid='github-approve-push'] -> /api/github/commit responded 404. Backend log: 'GET https://api.github.com/repos/rocosfsintec-del/Promethius/git/ref/heads/prom-chat-uitest HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found'. No commit-link ever rendered; no branch created. Skill: ai-testing-llm.

critical.issue: When create_branch=true, base_branch sent by the frontend equals the (yet-to-be-created) target branch, so GitHub returns 404 fetching the base ref. Root cause is that the push_proposal from the chat tool does not carry the repo's real default_branch; the FE fills repo.default_branch with initialProposal.branch. Nothing pushes end-to-end from chat-driven proposals for a new branch.

integration_issues.issue: GithubPush.jsx useEffect sets repo.default_branch = initialProposal.branch. That value is later used as base_branch when create_branch=true, causing a 404 loop. Fix: backend _make_push_proposal should include the repo's real default_branch (fetch via _repo_default_branch); frontend should map that to repo.default_branch, and initialProposal.branch stays only as the target 'branch'.

rca of the issue: propose_github_push (server.py:788) returns {branch, create_branch, ...} but not default_branch. GithubPush.jsx (line 76-81) stores initialProposal.branch as BOTH repo.default_branch and the target branch. On Approve, the FE sends base_branch = repo.default_branch = 'prom-chat-uitest', and /api/github/commit does GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/ref/heads/prom-chat-uitest which 404s (branch doesn't exist yet - that's what we were about to create). Fix in ONE line each on FE and BE: BE include default_branch in the proposal (fetched via _repo_default_branch); FE map initialProposal.default_branch (fallback 'main') to repo.default_branch.
